name: browser-extension
description: Chrome extension that fills logins from the password vault on your Quark

scripts.package: npm run build && (cd dist/chrome && zip -qr ../../quark-vault-chrome.zip .) && (cd dist/firefox && zip -qr ../../quark-vault-firefox.zip .)
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext@8 lint --source-dir dist/firefox --self-hosted
